row.notes: Preset applier (caller 0x14173d1a0 at 0x14173d332). Finds the session-settings component: game_mode+0xf08 if its type (vtable +0x28 of +0x18) derives from descriptor 0x146076520, else the first child in +0x238..+0x240 that does; none -> return. Reads '<prefix>.Game.time_of_day' (Ne_Config_GetString 0x143a44700, default empty, lowercased with Ne_Crt_ToLower 0x14536123c). Empty: nothing. 'official' (0x14565b23c): component+0xbb1 = 0. Otherwise lowercase FNV-1a64 of the value is compared with 8 hashes; a known name sets +0xbb1 = 2 (custom) and +0xbb2 = slot: sunrise 0, morning 1, midday 2, afternoon 3, sunset 4, night1 5, night2 6, night3 7 (names recovered by hashing); an unknown name behaves like official. Writes only when component+0xbb8 is non-null. hidden-modes 2026-11-13 (vmknolle-hidden-a): read from the Ghidra decompile.
